summary.text: You cannot be covered by both CareShield Life and ElderShield. You can upgrade to CareShield Life for higher and lifetime payouts.

details.heading: If you upgrade
details.body: Your ElderShield coverage will end when you join CareShield Life. Your ElderShield Supplement plan will not be affected if you already have one.

details.heading: More coverage
details.body: You can also buy Supplement plans from private insurers.
